prompts.name: map_from_image
prompts.title: Draw a map from a picture
prompts.description: Recreate a reference picture (screenshot, render or hand sketch) as a tile map with the user's tilesets and stamps.

arguments.name: reference
arguments.description: Absolute path of the picture (.png/.jpg/.webp), or a referenceId from get_session.references.

arguments.name: map
arguments.description: Map name or id to draw on (default: the active map).

prompts.template:
Recreate the picture {{reference}} as a tile map on {{map}} in Harita. Use only Harita tools (no shell, Python or files).

1. get_session: find the map id, layers, smart sources (smart) and references. If {{reference}} is a file path, call reference_add {path}; if it is already listed in references, use its referenceId.
2. reference_view {referenceId, mapId} to read the picture on the map grid. Look at the art: get_tile_catalog for each tileset, list_stamps {includeSheet:true}.
3. begin_edit {mapIds:[mapId], requestLabel}. Keep transactionId and resumeToken.
4. reference_quantize {referenceId, mapId} (mode sketch with colorLegend for flat-colour drawings: map each colour to a tile, tag word or {stampId}). Paint its grid.layers with one paint_grid call (layers:[...]).
5. Redraw rivers and roads with draw_path (smart source from get_session.smart, points at the bends, width 2–3) so banks and corners are proper; ponds and lakes with smart_brush mode area.
6. Place houses, bridges and trees with place_stamp (positions for many copies), matching the picture's sizes and colours.
7. render_compare {referenceId, mapId, mode:"side"}; fix the listed mismatches with paint_grid / replace_tiles / clear_region; repeat until it matches.
8. validate_map, finish_edit {summary}, and tell the user the draft waits for Onayla.

prompts.name: map_from_text
prompts.title: Draw a map from a description
prompts.description: Design a tile map from a text description with the user's tilesets and stamps.

arguments.name: description
arguments.description: What to draw, e.g. 'a village with a river, a bridge, a road and five houses'.

arguments.name: map
arguments.description: Map name or id to draw on (default: the active map).

prompts.template:
Draw this on {{map}} in Harita: {{description}}
Use only Harita tools (no shell, Python or files).

1. get_session: map id, layers, smart sources (smart). get_tile_catalog for each tileset and list_stamps {includeSheet:true} to see the art and stamp sizes.
2. Plan the layout in map cells (x right, y down): main features first (water, roads), then buildings and details. Keep paths connected and leave room around stamps.
3. begin_edit {mapIds:[mapId], requestLabel}. Keep transactionId and resumeToken.
4. Ground: one paint_grid call over the whole map with a {random:[...]} legend entry for natural grass variation.
5. Rivers and roads: draw_path with a smart source (points at the bends; width 3 for a river, 1–2 for a road). Ponds and lakes: smart_brush mode area. Bridges with place_stamp where a road crosses water.
6. Buildings, trees and fences: place_stamp (positions for many copies of one stamp).
7. render_preview {grid:true, coordinates:true}; zoom into details; fix with paint_grid / replace_tiles / clear_region.
8. validate_map, finish_edit {summary}, and tell the user the draft waits for Onayla.
